description: Inspection (bedek) and warranty periods for defects in a new apartment under the Israeli Sale (Apartments) Law, by type of defect, from the delivery date. Runs the official calculator of il-law.co.il.

contract_date.description: Contract signing date (determines which version of the law applies), YYYY-MM-DD

discovery_date.description: Date the defect was discovered (optional), YYYY-MM-DD
